sentences.text: 1. Heard on the question of admission.
2. Appeal is admitted for final hearing.
3. Also, heard on I.A No.1678/2023, which is first application under Section 389 of Cr.P.C for suspension of sentence filed on behalf of appellant.

4. The appellant has been convicted and sentenced as under:-
imprisonment fine, if Section Act Imprisonment in default of deposited fine 420 IPC 5 years R.I Rs.2000/- 3 months R.I 467 IPC 5 Years R.I Rs.2000/- 3 months R.I 468 IPC 5 years R.I Rs.2000/- 3 months R.I 471 IPC 5 years R.I Rs.2000/- 3 months R.I 5.
As per prosecution case, a complaint was made by one Omprakash that his father had never sold the agricultural land to anyone.
However, on the basis of a forged sale deed, the appellant filed mutation proceedings and got the land mutated in his favour.

6. Counsel for the appellant submits that the aforesaid land was purchased in the year 1963 by registered sale deed from the father of the complainant namely Basantilal and on the basis of the aforesaid sale deed the mutation proceedings were filed.
He has drawn attention of the Court on para 43 and 105 of the judgment and submit that the prosecution has failed to prove that the sale deed is a forged document.

He further submits that the merely because the appellant filed mutation proceedings on the basis of the sale deed, it cannot be presumed that the offences have been committed and, therefore, the conviction is not sustainable.

1 appellant is a 75 years old person and he was on bail during trial and did not misuse the liberty.
7.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Counsel for the State and the objector opposes the prayer and supports the order of conviction and sentence and submits that as per few reports of the Registrar Office, it was found that the papers of the register in the office were removed and substituted by forged documents.
However, the person who had conducted inquiry DIG, Registration has not been examined by the prosecution.
8. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the fact that prima facie prosecution has failed to prove that the sale deed alleged to be a forged document.
The appellant is a 75 years old person.
He was on bail during trial and did not misuse the liberty, I am of the view that the appellant is entitled for grant of suspension of sentence.
9. Accordingly, I.A No.1678/2023 is allowed.

The jail sentence of appellant is suspended upon his/her depositing the fine amount and on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.1,00,000/-(Rupees one lakh only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his/her appearance before the Registry of this Court on 28.8.2023 and on subsequent dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Registry.
10. With the aforesaid, I.A is allowed and disposed off.
11. As a consequence, I.A no.4115/2023, which is an application for urgent hearing also stands disposed off.

12. List the matter in due course.
CC as per rules.
